rca_of_the_issue: Iter 92.63c backend log at 2026-07-02 01:08:08 shows the mirror payload now trips a NEW Supabase error: code 428C9 (generated-column violation) on `email_lower`. The main-agent's Iter 92.63b fix — which correctly added `source_platform:'leaderos'` — ALSO added `email_lower:user['email'].lower()`, but `public.users.email_lower` in this Supabase project is a computed column (`GENERATED ALWAYS AS (lower(email)) STORED`), so any explicit value is rejected. Fix is to DELETE the `email_lower` key from the payload. After that, the mirror insert should succeed (id, email, source_platform are all valid columns), public.users row is created, and the leadership_insights FK 23503 will finally resolve. Verified via direct Supabase probe in Iter 92.63b that existing rows contain a computed `email_lower` value even when it isn't in the INSERT. Additionally: chat vocabulary bug (test_5) is independent — services.py L508 emits the correct instruction, but either (a) `wladhub_scores` isn't stored on the user doc after /api/wladhub/import, or (b) /api/chat's structured-output schema drops free-form dimension names from the answer body.
